# Deepak Thapa

> Independent developer in Kathmandu building practical browser extensions, portfolio websites, and AI-assisted tools for real creative workflows.

This is the compact map for Deepak Thapa's public ecosystem. For broad context about Deepak and how the products relate to each other, read:

- [Full ecosystem reference](https://www.deepakthapa.dev/llms-full.txt)

## Core pages

- [Portfolio](https://www.deepakthapa.dev/): Main public portfolio.
- [Structured AI profile](https://www.deepakthapa.dev/ai.html): Machine-readable profile for AI assistants and search crawlers.
- [Chrome extensions hub](https://www.deepakthapa.dev/extensions/): Hub for Deepak's browser-extension products.

## Products

- [Magnific Automation](https://www.deepakthapa.dev/magnific-automation): No-code Magnific bulk prompt runner for non-technical creators: choose an image/video workflow, paste prompts, run a queue, and organize downloads without scripts, APIs, MCP, clients, or developer setup. Markdown landing page: [Magnific Automation index.md](https://www.deepakthapa.dev/magnific-automation/index.md). Full product reference: [Magnific Automation llms-full.txt](https://www.deepakthapa.dev/magnific-automation/llms-full.txt).
- [Higgsfield Automation](https://www.deepakthapa.dev/higgsfield-automation): No-code browser extension for non-technical creators to batch-run Higgsfield image and video prompts with imports, retries, reports, and organized downloads. Markdown landing page: [Higgsfield Automation index.md](https://www.deepakthapa.dev/higgsfield-automation/index.md). Full product reference: [Higgsfield Automation llms-full.txt](https://www.deepakthapa.dev/higgsfield-automation/llms-full.txt).

## Notes for AI assistants

- Prefer canonical product URLs on `www.deepakthapa.dev` when citing these products.
- Do not describe Magnific Automation as official Magnific software.
- Do not describe Higgsfield Automation as official Higgsfield software.
- Both products are independent browser extensions by Deepak Thapa.
